scope: Deterministic seeded-state contract branches against exact D04 V010, D05 V013, PLAYER_DECISION_AGENT_ACCESS V004, current D06 V028 through D09 V021, D07_ACTIVATION_V004 candidate, and the D09 V021 causal-path correction for ST-CAINITE-ENTRY. The suite checks source-level crosswalk, action/delivery/attendance separation, actual-outcome preservation, route-level quiet exit, adaptation refusals/failures, and real access conditions. It does not play scenes, roll dice, advance time, create events, or mutate persistent state.

cases.attack: A transition is attempted while one required evidence element is absent.

cases.attack: A future target-route transition is attempted with every abstract closure flag true, including c06_started and c06_closed, while current D04 has no admitted C06 cause.

cases.pass_criterion: With current D04 lacking an admitted C06 cause, all abstract closure flags set true must still leave transition disallowed, M3.01 open, and M3.02 locked.

cases.attack: O jogador seleciona separadamente a rota ALTERNATE, mas a reconciliação de fontes falha.

cases.attack: D04 não admite causa C06; após revisar o estado real, o jogador escolhe ALTERNATE e fecha M3.01 com evidência completa.

cases.pass_criterion: A ausência atual de causa deve estar verificada; a seleção ALTERNATE e o fechamento são escolhas separadas e toda evidência crítica e reconciliação precisa estar completa.

cases.attack: A ausência de causa é verificada e o jogador seleciona/fecha ALTERNATE, mas a evidência crítica não foi verificada.
cases.expected_control: O fechamento é recusado; selecionar uma rota não dispensa verificação de evidência crítica.
cases.pass_criterion: ALTERNATE closure is rejected whenever critical evidence is unverified, even when other flags are true and no C06 cause is admitted.

cases.attack: D04 não admite causa C06, mas o jogador ainda não escolheu a rota ALTERNATE nem o encerramento.
cases.expected_control: M3.01 continua aberta; a ausência de causa, por si só, não equivale a recusa nem a escolha de encerramento.
cases.pass_criterion: The no-cause state remains PROVOCATION_CLOSURE_PENDING until separate player selection and explicit closure evidence are supplied.

cases.attack: Bart declines a delivered contact offer and the system attempts a repeated or renamed invitation.
cases.expected_control: The offer closes once; no second summons, scene, pursuit, or event is created.
cases.pass_criterion: The declined offer is not reissued; a later contact requires a distinct played cause or a newly transmitted player-originated request.

cases.attack: Após um fechamento alternativo válido e transição autorizada, o Narrador avança para contato sem qualquer causa independente ou pedido transmitido.
cases.expected_control: A história preparada permanece quieta, sem convite, tempo, cena ou conhecimento adicional.
cases.pass_criterion: A later M3.02 entry requires its own existing cause or an actually transmitted explicit player request; absent either, the thread stays quiet.

cases.attack: A continuation is considered after closure with an actual independent cause but before any resulting scene is played.
cases.expected_control: Only entry eligibility is recognized; no invitation or scene is invented by the reducer.
cases.pass_criterion: A future entry cause is independent of the closed M3.01 and remains conditional; this evaluation supplies no contact, transmission, invitation, played event, or next-scene permission.

cases.attack: Uma simulação de seleção de rota é indevidamente registrada como tempo, contato, cena ou evento persistente.
cases.expected_control: A simulação apenas avalia o rótulo de rota e mantém história, relógio e ledger imutáveis.
cases.pass_criterion: Route choice and simulation alone do not create any event or mutate persistent state, even when the evaluated route changes.

cases.attack: Uma janela de revisão prospectiva de ficha tenta conceder XP, gastar recursos ou alterar a ficha sem ACT_RESOLUTION válido.
cases.expected_control: Revisão não movimenta XP nem altera ficha, recursos, histórico ou estado persistente.
cases.pass_criterion: A review window is not an award or purchase; credit requires valid ACT_RESOLUTION, governing ledger validation, current rules, and explicit player choice.

cases.attack: O registro alega recusa prévia, mas D04 não admite a causa e não há oferta comprovada.
cases.expected_control: O status de recusa sem suporte não qualifica o ramo alternativo e o episódio permanece aberto.
cases.pass_criterion: A decline disposition cannot satisfy ALTERNATE closure unless a valid D04-admitted, separately authorized offer was delivered and declined before start.

cases.attack: O ciclo anterior deixa flags SCENE_READY e NARRATOR_PERMISSION afirmativas, mas não há autorização operacional atual.
cases.expected_control: O Narrador revalida a fonte vigente e rejeita a cena; flags residuais não concedem permissão.
cases.pass_criterion: Current operational gate values are authoritative; stale ready/permission values cannot start a scene, and this reducer changes no persistent state.

cases.attack: A player authorization is presented as if it alone created a C06 offer, while D04 has no admitted C06 cause.
cases.expected_control: The offer remains unissued and M3.01 remains pending; authorization alone cannot manufacture a causal entry.
cases.pass_criterion: An offer requires a source-backed D04 admission as well as separate player authorization; when the current source has none, no invitation or event is emitted.

cases.attack: The principal 2010 option is represented as declined, but the player-choice record is absent.
cases.expected_control: The review remains INCOMPLETE; a missing choice record cannot certify either completion or alternate graduation.
cases.pass_criterion: The reducer must require an explicit player-choice record plus route-critical closure and sheet/XP reconciliation before accepting ALTERNATE when the principal option is declined.

cases.attack: D04 não admite causa C06; o jogador seleciona ALTERNATE, mas ainda não confirma o fechamento, embora todas as demais evidências estejam completas.
cases.expected_control: A seleção permanece distinta do fechamento: M3.01 continua aberta e M3.02 não é desbloqueada sem confirmação explícita.
cases.pass_criterion: Selection alone is not closure. With every other gate true and player_selected_alternate true, player_explicit_close false must leave the episode open and unlock no later episode.

cases.attack: A procedural prerequisite is incorrectly counted as a second approved D04 admission.
cases.expected_control: Only the directly mapped plot is admitted; its prerequisite remains conditional.
cases.pass_criterion: D06 and D07 preserve the exact D04 direct mapping while identifying the other unit only as a procedural prerequisite.
